//: Telemetry sink configuration. A PostHog project API key is a write-only ingest key designed to be embedded in client code, so committing it here is expected and safe — it cannot read data back. Set `api_key` to enable sending; while it is empty, events spool locally and nothing leaves the machine. `file_issues` stays false for the Phase 1 observe-only rollout; flip it to true for Phase 2 once dedup has been proven against a scratch repo. Env overrides for local testing: RAFTKIT_POSTHOG_HOST, RAFTKIT_POSTHOG_KEY, RAFTKIT_ISSUE_REPO, RAFTKIT_FILE_ISSUES.
